pages.title: Cursed gift
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Cursed gift casts you as a commander revived by Death to save a kingdom overrun by cultists and possessed enemies. Raise defeated foes and build an undead army from skeletons, zombies, and liches, combining squads as you direct them in battle.

Move the commander with WASD and activate abilities with Q, E, R, and F. Left-click a squad to select it, or drag a selection box to choose several, then right-click to issue orders. Hold C to choose a potion from the wheel and use Escape to pause.

pages.title: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots
pages.creator: gameVgames
pages.description: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots sends you out to smash eggs, collect Brainrot characters, and bring them back to your base before the timer expires. Balance the search for rare characters with the need to return in time. Move with WASD, sprint with Left Shift, and jump with Space. Attack with a left-click or F, and use E to pick up or sell.

pages.title: Office Knight 3D: Castle Defense
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Office Knight 3D: Castle Defense puts an office warrior into three-dimensional battles against waves of enemies. Fight with swords and axes, collect coins, and improve the hero's health and damage as you level up. A shop provides equipment and further upgrades.

On a keyboard, move with WASD, left-click to attack, press Space to jump, and use Left Shift to sprint. Q changes weapons, while E opens the shop when you approach it. Touch controls use a movement joystick and action buttons, with swipes rotating the camera.

pages.title: Card Solitaire: Word Game
pages.creator: Bravestars Games
pages.description: Card Solitaire: Word Game turns word associations into a card-sorting puzzle. Place every card in its correct category before using up the available moves. Cards can show pictures or words, so identify the topic that links them and organize the whole set. The subjects range from familiar objects and animals to more abstract ideas.

pages.title: Capybara Mukbang ASMR
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Capybara Mukbang ASMR combines cooking, dressing up, and a food livestream. Prepare dishes such as hamburgers, pizza, and ice cream, then have the capybara taste them. Eat and drink for the livestream audience and see how many likes the performance receives. Use clicks or taps to work through the activities.

pages.title: Ball Sort
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Ball Sort asks you to gather each color of ball into its own tube. Tap a tube to select its uppermost ball, then choose a destination with enough room and a compatible color. Plan transfers to finish with fewer moves. Undo lets you correct a decision, an additional bottle provides more working space, and restarting lets you try the level again.

pages.title: Merge 2048 Cake
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Merge 2048 Cake is a number-merging puzzle where a group must contain at least three identical tiles. Click or tap the matching group to combine it into a tile worth twice as much. Build larger values and chain merges while working toward 2048. Coins and boosters, including the Rocket, Magnet, and Sorter, help clear space before the board fills.

pages.title: Tile Living
pages.creator: Synk Inc.
pages.description: Tile Living combines tile-linking puzzles with room decoration. Tap matching tiles whose connection can be drawn using no more than three straight segments. Remove every tile to finish the stage, then spend the coins earned from completed stages on decorating your room. Look for available connections as you clear each layout.

pages.title: Halloween Match Trio
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Halloween Match Trio has you swap themed items into horizontal or vertical rows containing at least three matches. Make combinations to unlock the board's tiles and progress through 75 levels. Bombs, arrows, magnets, and other power-ups help clear difficult arrangements. Use a mouse or touchpad to swap the pieces and work toward the final stage.

pages.title: Galaxy Clicker
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Galaxy Clicker is a space-themed clicking game centered on revolving planets. Hold the left mouse button or use touch input to speed up their motion as you progress through its galactic setting.

pages.title: Connect Em All
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Connect Em All is a dot-connection puzzle in which every dot needs a matching-color connection. Drag from one dot to another of its color, arranging the lines so they fit without overlapping. If a route blocks your plan, click its line to erase it and redraw the connection. Finish linking the whole set to complete the puzzle.

pages.title: Gun Match Screw
pages.creator: QiGame
pages.description: Gun Match Screw presents screw puzzles on boards shaped like firearms and their parts. Match the colors of screws represented by bullets to unlock the boards in each level. Use the left mouse button to make selections and work through the gun-shaped assemblies.

pages.title: Number Master Run And Merge
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Number Master Run And Merge sends a number character along a parkour track. Collect more numbers and combine with matching ones to increase your value and strength. Choose routes through the course and use speed zones to keep moving quickly. Click or tap to control the run as you build a larger number.

pages.title: Paint Roller
pages.creator: Caner
pages.description: Paint Roller gives you two spheres joined by an elastic tether. Click to hold one sphere in place while its partner swings around it, spreading paint along the way. Use the pair's rotation to cover every target cylinder in the level. The challenge is choosing anchor points that let the swinging sphere reach the remaining unpainted areas.

pages.title: Spider Solitaire
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Spider Solitaire challenges you to organize cards into complete runs of a single suit, descending from King to Ace. Finished runs disappear from the table, making room to continue sorting. Build descending arrangements and tap the deck at the top when you need another deal. Choose one, two, or four suits for the easy, medium, or hard setting, and complete every run to win.

pages.title: Snap Fix
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Snap Fix is a timed picture-sliding puzzle with one vacant square. Click a tile to move it into that gap, rearranging the grid until the scrambled image is restored. Finish before the countdown ends to unlock the completed picture and download it as a reward. Plan how to use the empty space while keeping track of the remaining time.

pages.title: Bounce Dunk Basketball
pages.creator: Online Games
pages.description: Bounce Dunk Basketball challenges you to bounce a basketball into the basket with carefully judged shots. Tap or click to control the shot's angle and strength, using the bounce to reach the hoop. Score points, collect coins, and take out enemies during the challenges as you work on more accurate launches.

pages.title: Glitch
pages.creator: Liminal Creations Pvt. Ltd.
pages.description: Glitch is a two-dimensional platformer built around puzzle-solving and glitching platforms. Work out how to cross each arrangement and reach the exit door. Move left and right with A and D or the arrow keys, and jump with W, Up arrow, or Space. Each level adds another platforming puzzle to overcome.

pages.title: Lunar Phase Battle
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Lunar Phase Battle is a turn-based strategy game played with moon-phase cards. Place a card on an empty tile by clicking, tapping, or dragging it there. Form pairs or cycles to capture tiles and add to your score. Both sides can reclaim the other's tiles, so consider how each placement affects the next available combinations.

pages.title: Stickman Rogue Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Stickman Rogue Online sends a stickman into a survival battle against increasingly difficult enemy waves. Gather experience and energy boosters during the fighting, then improve abilities such as movement speed, attack, and defense. Use mouse clicks or taps to play as you develop the character and try to withstand more enemies.

pages.title: Ball Dunk Fall
pages.creator: POKET GEAR
pages.description: Ball Dunk Fall has you steer a ball as it drops through a course of hoops and obstacles. Tap to adjust its direction and guide it through as many hoops as possible for a higher score. Time those changes carefully: hitting an obstacle or leaving the play area ends the run.

pages.title: Eat Blobs Simulator
pages.creator: CursoraLabs
pages.description: Eat Blobs Simulator puts you in an arena where eating smaller blobs makes your slime grow. Chase suitable targets, collect blobs around the arena, and raise your score and size. Rewards and coins let you buy other blob skins. Play alone or with a second player: player one uses WASD, while player two moves with the arrow keys. Mouse controls adjust the camera and zoom.

pages.title: Climate Activist
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Climate Activist follows a character causing disruption in art galleries with materials such as eggs, tomatoes, stickers, and spray paint. Carry out the acts while avoiding detection by the gallery's watchers. Move with WASD or the arrow keys, press Space to jump, and hold Left Shift to sprint. Use the mouse to control the camera as you watch the surroundings.

pages.title: OXY - Words maker
pages.creator: DAPALAB
pages.description: OXY - Words maker is a letter puzzle featuring synonyms, antonyms, and oxymorons. Click letters in the correct order to assemble the hidden word in each challenge. Accurate answers entered quickly earn extra points. If a combination leaves you stuck, use a hint to help work out the word.

pages.title: Word Search Summer
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Word Search Summer asks you to locate every word listed beside a letter grid. Select a word's first letter and trace a straight route through to its final letter. Words can run horizontally, vertically, or diagonally in either direction. Use a mouse or touchpad to mark each discovery and clear the list to finish the level.

pages.title: Ballon Slicer
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Ballon Slicer is a puzzle about throwing a saw through groups of balloons. Aim the launch and use rebounds from walls to reach the targets, trying to burst every balloon. Earn stars and rewards across fifty levels. Keys open hidden chests containing additional rewards or skins, giving you more to find while clearing the arrangements.

pages.title: Zombie Paradise - Fury Road
pages.creator: Dinmo Games
pages.description: Zombie Paradise - Fury Road combines zombie-crushing drives with vehicle arena battles. On the endless road, run over zombies to earn credits, keeping in mind that higher speed increases the risk of exploding. In the arena, force rival cars out and remain as the winner, with a zombie boss offering another scoring opportunity. Spend earnings on different cars. Steer with WASD or the arrow keys and pause with Escape.

pages.title: 4x4 Monster Truck Driving 3d
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: 4x4 Monster Truck Driving 3d puts a large-wheeled truck on off-road missions through steep climbs, winding routes, snow, and rain. Guide it through the individual course challenges and handle the changing terrain. Use W to accelerate, S to reverse, and A or D to steer. Space applies the brake, and P pauses the game.

pages.title: Mr Noob Vs Zombies
pages.creator: Noob vs Pro team
pages.description: Mr Noob Vs Zombies is a shooting game about clearing zombies and opening Lucky Blocks. Help Noob work through a campaign of one thousand zombies, unlocking new character skins from the blocks along the way. Click the screen to shoot on a computer, or tap when using touch input.

pages.title: Princes of Light
pages.creator: Renan Games
pages.description: Princes of Light is a castle adventure playable alone or cooperatively. Find the orbs and bring them into contact to open the door onward, overcoming the castle's challenges as you go. In solo play, move with the arrow keys, jump with C, attack with X, and switch characters with Z. For two players, the first uses A and D, V to jump, and B to attack; the second moves with arrows, jumps with numpad 2, and attacks with numpad 3.

pages.title: Super Marius World
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Super Marius World follows little Marius on a running and jumping adventure toward his castle. Guide the character through the platforming route and work out how to keep progressing. Use WASD or the arrow keys to move and jump, or use the on-screen movement and jump buttons with touch input.

pages.title: Breacking Blocks
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Breacking Blocks is a matching puzzle in which the pieces fall into play. Position the incoming blocks to form a row of three with the same color and make them disappear. Drag with a mouse or touch input to move the blocks, planning where to place each one so the next matching row can form.

pages.title: Amazing Anime Puzzle
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Amazing Anime Puzzle is a picture-tile puzzle featuring anime artwork. Choose a puzzle theme and rearrange the tiles to restore its complete image. Use the picture's details to work out where each fragment belongs.

pages.title: Sky Roller
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Sky Roller puts you on skates with direct control over the distance between the character's legs. Swipe left or right to spread or bring them together, choosing a stance that avoids obstacles on the course. Reach the finish without crashing and continue through the levels toward the bonus challenge.

pages.title: Tomb of the Mask Neon
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Tomb of the Mask Neon sends you through mazes filled with traps, spikes, and enemies. Slide in a chosen direction and keep moving until an obstacle stops you, planning each route around the hazards. Progress opens masks that grant different powers. Use arrow keys or swipes to explore the neon labyrinths and reach the secret mask.

pages.title: Zrist
pages.creator: NoaDev
pages.description: Zrist is an obstacle-dodging game whose rules keep changing as you progress. Jump and slide through more than seventy levels while adapting to seven different rules. On a computer, jump with X or a left-click and slide with C or a right-click. With touch controls, the right side jumps and the left side slides.

pages.title: Midnight Witches Jigsaw
pages.creator: Best Games
pages.description: Midnight Witches Jigsaw offers six witch-themed pictures to reconstruct. Choose an image and one of three modes, then drag its pieces into place with the mouse. Match the fragments to their positions until the complete picture takes shape.

pages.title: Pool Party
pages.creator: Azerion Games
pages.description: Pool Party takes you to a water park with Bunni for balloon-matching puzzles. Swap pool items to make matches and meet each level's targets, removing dirt, algae, and rubbish along the way. Combinations of four or more create power-ups. Beach balls, water guns, and special balloons help clear larger areas or whole lines. Play with mouse or touch controls.

pages.title: Gravity Square
pages.creator: FBK
pages.description: Gravity Square challenges you to get a square to the exit using jumps directed away from your input. Click or tap on the opposite side from where you want it to travel. Judge that reversed movement as you guide the square toward the door in each arrangement.

pages.title: SUSHI CHEF
pages.creator: wey.game
pages.description: SUSHI CHEF is a one-button game about rolling up ingredients along a moving course. Hold the mouse button to lower the roll onto the food, then release to lift it over nails and insects. Ingredients add layers and increase its size, while unwanted objects damage your progress. Bring the growing sushi roll to the finish.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Cure For The Prince
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Hidden Objects Cure For The Prince follows Beatrix, a sorceress seeking medicine for an ill prince in Lafral. Search each scene for the objects shown in the list on the left before the timer expires. Use a hint when you cannot find an item, or open the magnifying-glass view to zoom and drag around the scene.

pages.title: Santa Quest
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Santa Quest is a path-building puzzle about helping Santa after he loses his way and his gifts. Slide road tiles into a connected route to the goal, working around stone tiles that stay fixed. Try to solve the arrangement with fewer moves. Three modes offer more puzzles, and hints can help when you cannot see the next useful shift.

pages.title: Hidden Objects Dreamy Realm
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Hidden Objects Dreamy Realm has sixteen dreamlike scenes to search. Find the items listed on the left before each scene's time runs out. A hint button helps with elusive objects, while the magnifying glass lets you zoom in and drag around the picture to inspect smaller details.

pages.title: Nature Jigsaw Puzzle Butterfly
pages.creator: GamesFine.com
pages.description: Nature Jigsaw Puzzle Butterfly lets you rebuild eight butterfly pictures from separate pieces. Choose a two-by-three, three-by-four, or four-by-six layout, then drag each fragment to its correct position with the mouse. Complete the image by fitting all of its parts into the chosen grid.

pages.title: Gravity Aliens
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Gravity Aliens challenges you to move an alien past obstacles and through a magic exit gate. Click or tap to reverse gravity, changing the direction in which the character travels. Time those changes to get through the hazards and work through thirty levels.

pages.title: Flippy Knife Neon
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Flippy Knife Neon is a weapon-tossing game featuring knives, axes, and swords. Flip and throw the weapons, collect coins, and spend them on upgrades while building a collection. Use mouse or touch input to play through the throwing challenges.

pages.title: Pickup Trucks Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Pickup Trucks Jigsaw lets you assemble pictures of pickup trucks. Select an image, choose its difficulty, and use the mouse to drag the pieces into their proper places. Fit the fragments together until the chosen truck picture is complete.

pages.title: Summer 2020 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Summer 2020 Puzzle offers six summer-themed images as jigsaws. For each picture, choose a layout containing 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Use the mouse to assemble the image, selecting a larger piece count when you want more fragments to organize.

pages.title: River Coach Bus Driving Simulator Games 2020
pages.creator: toplight studio
pages.description: River Coach Bus Driving Simulator Games 2020 puts you in a water-bus driving and racing setting. Guide the coach across the water and handle its turns while taking part in the driving challenges.

pages.title: Pixelcraft Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Pixelcraft Jigsaw has twelve picture puzzles that unlock in sequence. Begin with the first image and complete it to open the next one. Each picture offers 25 pieces on easy, 49 on medium, or 100 on hard. Use mouse or touch input to assemble the fragments as you progress through the collection.

pages.title: Chained Tractor Towing Rescue
pages.creator: hitNrun games
pages.description: Chained Tractor Towing Rescue puts you behind the wheel for tractor-towing missions. Use the chained vehicle to carry out rescues and clear the blocked traffic. Each level has a different task and a time limit, so complete the towing job before the allotted time runs out.

pages.title: Fishing with Touch
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Fishing with Touch is a timed fish-catching game controlled directly on the screen. Click or tap the fish to catch them, aiming to take as many as possible before the clock runs down. Keep selecting the fish you see to increase the catch within the available time.

pages.title: Flappy Chick
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Flappy Chick follows a flightless chicken traveling with a jet pack. Use the left mouse button or Space to flap through the route and avoid its obstacles. Keep the chicken from colliding with anything as you try to extend the distance traveled.

pages.title: Circle Dot
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Circle Dot challenges you to keep a dot inside a circle for as long as possible. Touch either side of the screen to rotate the circle left or right. Adjust its rotation as you play and try to maintain the dot's position for a longer run.

pages.title: Casino Cards Memory
pages.creator: GameNing
pages.description: Casino Cards Memory asks you to uncover pairs of identical cards. Click or tap two cards and remember their positions: a correct match adds money, while a mistake deducts it. The game ends if the money runs out. Levels also have different time limits, and you must finish matching the cards before the countdown expires.

pages.title: Season Wiping Window
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Season Wiping Window is a window-cleaning activity with a choice of seasons. Select the seasonal setting, then use mouse or touch input to wipe the window.

pages.title: Kids Memory Wild Animals
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Kids Memory Wild Animals combines animal pictures with a memory activity. Click the squares to reveal wild animals and hear their names, using the pictures and sounds to become familiar with them. Play with the mouse as you remember which animal appears in each position.

pages.title: Mad Scientist Run
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Mad Scientist Run sends a scientist to defend a city attacked by aliens and demons. Move through the action and shoot the enemies to carry out the rescue assignment. Play with the arrow keys and Space, or use the touch-screen controls.

pages.title: Avalanche Santa Ski Xmas
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Avalanche Santa Ski Xmas has Santa ski downhill ahead of an avalanche. Gather presents and travel farther to increase your score and unlock hidden characters. The shop lets you improve Santa's abilities. Tap to jump and keep holding to perform a backflip as you make your way down the mountain.

pages.title: New Year Santa Adventures
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: New Year Santa Adventures sends Santa through twenty platforming levels to recover presents stolen by an evil dragon. Defeat enemies, stay on the platforms, and find the exit from each area. Use the arrow keys or touch input to guide Santa through the lands and work toward rescuing the gifts.

pages.title: Xmas Rush
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Xmas Rush is a Christmas-themed driving race against the clock. Take the turns and avoid other vehicles while trying to finish within the time limit. Collisions and trips off the road reduce your speed, making it harder to reach the end in time. Control the car with the arrow keys.

pages.title: RC 125 Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: RC 125 Slide is a picture-sliding puzzle featuring the RC 125 motorcycle. Choose one of three images and one of three play modes, then use the mouse to rearrange the tiles. Restore the complete motorcycle picture by moving its fragments into position.

pages.title: Ambulance Rescue Games 2019
pages.creator: wingmangames
pages.description: Ambulance Rescue Games 2019 puts you on city rescue duty as an ambulance driver. Navigate traffic to reach people and transport them to hospital. A navigation system guides the journey, and a siren button lets you switch the warning sound on or off. Work through the rescue levels and customize different ambulances.

pages.title: Guess The Flag
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Guess The Flag tests whether you can identify a country from its flag. Look at the flag presented and use the mouse to choose the country it belongs to. Work through the flag-identification challenges as you compare the designs.

pages.title: Warrior Princess
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Warrior Princess lets you give Mia, Emma, and Bella warrior-inspired makeovers. Choose outfits that give each girl her own interpretation of the style, trying different looks across the three characters. Use the mouse to work through their makeover options.

pages.title: Bouncing Babies
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Bouncing Babies puts you in control of two firefighters holding a trampoline. Move them with the arrow keys to catch the falling babies and bounce them toward the ambulance. Judge where the babies will land so the team can keep them safely in motion toward the rescue vehicle.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Halloween Night
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Halloween Night follows Hazel and her friends through Halloween celebrations. Help them enjoy the themed games and activities, go trick-or-treating, dance, and visit the Halloween Food Hub. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and the other characters as they move through the evening.

pages.title: Hippo Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Hippo Jigsaw offers cartoon hippopotamus pictures to assemble. Select the image you like and choose how many pieces to use before starting. Tap to play and fit the fragments together until the selected hippo picture is complete.

pages.title: Doctor Kids Hospital
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Doctor Kids Hospital is a hospital game about treating different patients and performing emergency operations. Take the role of a doctor and use the available medical tools during the treatment activities. Control the game with the mouse as you work through the patients' care.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Pet Party
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Pet Party has Hazel organize a celebration to cheer up her pets. Help get the animals ready and take care of what they need when Hazel's friends bring their own pets along. Use the mouse to interact with Hazel and support the party activities as you keep the guests happy.

pages.title: Xtreme Real City Car Parking
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Xtreme Real City Car Parking challenges you to park cars around a supermarket building. Guide the vehicle through each level without colliding with barriers or other cars, then position it accurately in the parking area. Move with WASD and use Space to brake as you negotiate the available room.

pages.title: Red Hands
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Red Hands is a hand-slapping contest with attacking and dodging roles. Try to land hits on the opponent while keeping your own hand out of the way when defending. Play alone against the computer or choose the two-player option. Use the mouse and Space key for the actions.

pages.title: Air Combat Puzzle 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Air Combat Puzzle 2 offers six aircraft-combat pictures as jigsaws. Each image can be played with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces, giving you four difficulty choices. Use the mouse to put the fragments together and complete the chosen scene.

pages.title: Traffic Racer Game 3D
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Traffic Racer Game 3D challenges you to drive through traffic without crashing. Use the arrow keys to control the car, find gaps between other vehicles, and keep traveling along the road. Aim to cover more distance and make successful overtakes while handling the surrounding traffic.

pages.title: Easter Egg Hunt
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Easter Egg Hunt asks you to find Easter eggs before the countdown expires. Search through five levels and collect all the eggs required in each one. Use the mouse to select your discoveries as you work through the timed hunts.

pages.title: Perfect Halloween Girl
pages.creator: igirlgames
pages.description: Perfect Halloween Girl follows Molly, a witch preparing for a large Halloween gathering. Help with her makeover and choose an outfit for her appearance among the other witches and wizards. Put together a party look before she heads to the celebration on her broomstick.

pages.title: Cheese and Mouse
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Cheese and Mouse is a physics puzzle about getting a mouse to its food. Tap blocks to remove them and let the mouse slide toward the cheese. Work around objects such as bars, moving platforms, and balls as the arrangements become more difficult. Plan which supports to clear so their movement helps the mouse reach its destination.

pages.title: Purple Jewel Dress Up Game
pages.creator: Kawaii Games
pages.description: Purple Jewel Dress Up Game lets you create your own version of Jewel Girl. Choose clothing and other character items to make a casual look or recreate her different regenerations and fusions. Mix the available options to design another appearance for the character.

pages.title: Bad Girls Makeover
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Bad Girls Makeover gives Moana and Rapunzel a rebellious change of style. Experiment with darker lip colors, nose rings, tattoos, and outfits as you give both princesses new looks. Use the mouse to choose their makeup and clothing and put together each finished makeover.

pages.title: Thumb vs thumb
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Thumb vs thumb turns a saloon showdown into a thumb-wrestling contest. The two thumbs face a button between them, and pressing it earns points. Time your attempts so the opponent does not block your thumb. Reach the required score first to win the match.

pages.title: Clash of Warlord Orcs
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Clash of Warlord Orcs is a card-driven battle with three minutes to defeat the opposing orc force. Build your deck before fighting, then choose cards to deploy units and heroes on the battlefield. Options include infantry, ranged fighters, cavalry, heavy units, and spells. Combine their roles and respond to the enemy's forces while working within the short battle time.

pages.title: Barbie Wedding Planner
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Barbie Wedding Planner helps a couple choose where to hold their wedding. Visit two possible locations with the planner and decorate each venue. Try the available arrangements, then decide which finished setting should host the ceremony.

pages.title: Brick Breaker : The Ultimate Challenge
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Brick Breaker : The Ultimate Challenge has you move a paddle to keep a ball bouncing into bricks. Clear every breakable brick while preventing the ball from dropping past the bottom of the screen. Some bricks take several hits, so keep returning the ball until the remaining targets are destroyed.

pages.title: Poultry Farm Easter Escape
pages.creator: Yolkgames
pages.description: Poultry Farm Easter Escape is a point-and-click puzzle set during an Easter trip to a forest outside the city. Trapped there, you must search for useful objects and clues, then solve puzzles to find a way out. Click objects to inspect and interact with them as you work through the escape.

pages.title: Geometry neon dash Subzero
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Geometry neon dash Subzero challenges you to jump and fly through obstacle-filled levels. Click or tap to control the character and avoid the objects along the route. Collect balls to unlock additional characters as you continue through the neon courses.

pages.title: Dynamons 2
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Dynamons 2 returns to training creatures for battle. Prepare your Dynamons, then choose between different attacks and defensive actions to overcome their opponents.

pages.title: Aim Clash
pages.creator: Gamesign Studio
pages.description: Aim Clash is a shooting duel in which ricochets help you reach an opponent behind obstacles. Click or tap to aim and fire, using surfaces to bounce the projectile around the level's barriers. Each turn has a countdown, so choose a useful angle before the time runs out and try to defeat the rival.

pages.title: Temple of Diamonds
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Temple of Diamonds is a gem-matching puzzle played by swapping neighboring pieces. Click or swipe to form horizontal or vertical lines containing at least three gems of one color. Matches disappear and new pieces drop into the gaps, opening further combinations. Build your score while working against the time bar.

pages.title: Bake Time Pizzas
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Bake Time Pizzas puts you at a pizza counter taking customer orders. Select ingredients to match the requested recipe, then confirm the finished pizza for serving. Correct orders earn money, and more pizzas become available as you progress. Keep customers satisfied: too many angry diners end the game.

pages.title: Princesses at School of Magic
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Princesses at School of Magic combines packing with dress-up preparations. Help the princesses find the personal belongings they need after learning they have been admitted to magic school. Then choose their outfits, adding shoes and accessories to complete each student's new look.

pages.title: Dove Runway Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Dove Runway Dolly Dress Up H5 gets Dove ready for a fashion show using items hidden in mystery boxes. Open the boxes to reveal clothing and accessories, then build an outfit from the pieces you find. Combine tops, skirts, shoes, and bags into a runway look for the evening.
